I checked the org `AgentforceOrg`, not your local project files. No default org is configured. It's the only authorized org, so I used it.

## What references `RecordSelectorController`

Only two components depend on it. Both are in the org's dependency tracking (`MetadataComponentDependency`).

| Component | Type | How it uses the class |
|---|---|---|
| `recordSelector` | LWC bundle | Imports three methods from `@salesforce/apex/RecordSelectorController.*` in `recordSelector.js`: `searchRecords`, `saveSelectedRecords` and `getSelectedRecordsDetails` |
| `RecordSelectorControllerTest` | Apex class | Test class for the controller |

No other Apex class, trigger or LWC references it. Nothing in the controller calls out to other classes either. Its helper methods are private.

## What breaks if you rename it

- **`recordSelector` LWC:** All three imports use the literal class name (`@salesforce/apex/RecordSelectorController.searchRecords` and the other two). After a rename, the bundle fails to compile and won't deploy. Any record, app or home page that uses the component would also break. Fix this by updating those three import lines in `recordSelector.js`.
- **`RecordSelectorControllerTest`:** It won't compile, because it references the old name. Update its references. You'll probably want to rename the test class too.
- **Deployment:** Deploy the renamed class, the test class and the LWC together. If you only deploy the class, the org still has the LWC pointing at the old name.
- **Org-side leftovers:** Renaming the file locally doesn't remove the old class from the org. You'd have to delete `RecordSelectorController` separately. Profile and permission set `classAccess` entries for the old name would also need updating. I didn't check those.

## What I couldn't verify

- Dependency tracking can miss string-based references, such as `Type.forName('RecordSelectorController')`, and some flow or other metadata references. I didn't check for those.
- I couldn't search your local project folder because I have no file-search tool here. If the local source differs from the org, for example with uncommitted changes, there could be references I haven't seen.
- I didn't look at permission sets, profiles or flexipages. Flexipages reference the `recordSelector` component, not the class, so a class rename doesn't affect them.

I can make the rename if you want. I'd update the LWC imports and the test class, then deploy them together.
